values.note: 26 tent/RV sites and 36 lean-tos in two loops; all tent/RV sites are in the Tent Loop. The booking site lists 17 RV-capable sites, 13 of them 28-34 ft, and 8 tent-only sites. No pull-throughs.

note: Mountainside park in Coolidge State Forest, with a whole loop of lean-tos and a hilltop picnic area with a log shelter. The park warns that its 0.9-mile entrance road to the office is steep and narrow and challenging for large trailers and RVs. --Claude
summary: Park page + RA + 2026 map: 26 tent/RV (17 RV-capable), max 34 ft; no hookups; flush toilets, token showers, dump. Season manual (05-22/10-14) left: 2026's second Monday in October is Oct 12. Phone 802-672-3612 (stored blank). AGENCY ROAD WARNING (steep, narrow entrance road challenging for large trailers/RVs) - drop candidate for the reviewer. Tent Loop not placed under canopy.
